properties.name: amount_ceiling_no_tolerance
properties.description: An amount strictly over the mandate's ceiling always denies scope, no matter what every other field is set to -- there is no combination of matching currency, category, merchant, or timing that lets an over-ceiling transaction through.

properties.name: merchant_allowlist_cannot_be_bypassed
properties.description: When a mandate restricts to specific merchants, a transaction with an unlisted merchant always denies scope, regardless of every other field being otherwise fully compliant.

properties.name: expired_mandate_never_verifies
properties.description: A mandate presented after its own expires_at never verifies, regardless of signature validity, key registration, or remaining budget.

properties.name: budget_exhausted_mandate_never_verifies
properties.description: A mandate whose usage_count has reached its max_transaction_count never verifies, regardless of signature validity, key registration, or the time window.

properties.name: delegated_scope_only_attenuates
properties.description: Whenever containment accepts a delegated mandate, that mandate's ceiling, category reach, merchant allowlist, transaction window, and transaction count are each no broader than its parent's -- authority can only narrow across an accepted delegation, never widen.

properties.name: no_accepted_chain_exceeds_depth_bound
properties.description: Whenever containment accepts a delegated mandate, its resolved ancestor chain is no more than 3 hops deep -- an accepted chain never exceeds the configured depth bound.

properties.name: sibling_committed_total_never_exceeds_parent_cap
properties.description: For any group of up to 4 sibling mandates chained from one parent and decided in sequence by the real running-ledger algorithm, the sum of every accepted sibling's own ceiling never exceeds the parent's cap -- for every possible combination of sibling amounts in the bounded space, not just the ones any generated corpus happened to produce.

properties.name: no_session_both_allowed_and_flagged_for_hold
properties.layer: Combination logic (Layers 1, 2, 2.5, and Layer 3's abstracted contribution)
properties.description: No session can be simultaneously auto-approved and flagged for escalation to human review, for any combination of the deterministic layers' verdicts and any value Layer 3's own score might take.
